subject: chemistry
title: Stoichiometric Relationships Adventure 1: Moles and Avogadro's constant
welcome_lead: Today you'll count atoms with Avogadro's number — 6.02 × 10²³ in every mole.
meta_desc: Chemistry — moles, Avogadro 6.02×10²³, Mr calculations, mass-mole conversions.
final_note: You learned 1 mole = 6.02×10²³ particles, n=m/Mr, and stoichiometric ratios come from balanced equations.

concepts.def: Mass of 1 mole in g mol⁻¹

walkthroughs.body_html:
A mole contains exactly 6.02 × 10²³ particles — the same as atoms in 12.000 g of ¹²C.

This Avogadro constant NA links the atomic (g mol⁻¹) and macroscopic (grams) scales.

Example: 18.0 g of water = 1 mol = 6.02 × 10²³ H₂O molecules.

Master the triangle: n = m / Mr

- 5.85 g NaCl: Mr = 58.5, so n = 5.85/58.5 = 0.100 mol.
- 0.5 mol H₂SO₄: m = 0.5 × 98.0 = 49.0 g.

For solutions: c = n/V (mol dm⁻³).

From combustion or % composition, find moles of each element → divide by smallest → empirical formula.

Example: 40% C, 6.67% H, 53.3% O.
n(C) = 40/12 = 3.33; n(H) = 6.67/1 = 6.67; n(O) = 53.3/16 = 3.33.
Ratio: 1: 2: 1 → CH₂O.

If Mr = 180, molecular formula = (CH₂O)₆ = C₆H₁₂O₆ — glucose!

mcqs.q: How many moles in 36 g of water (Mr = 18)?
What does the M+ peak in a mass spectrum represent?
options: The molecular ion — formed when a single electron is removed from the whole molecule, giving the relative molecular mass.
The M+ peak shows the mass of a single hydrogen atom added to the molecule.
The M+ peak shows the mass of the largest fragment after the molecule breaks apart.

mcqs.q: If a complex ion has a coordination number of 4, what shape does it have?
options: A coordination number of 4 always means square planar because complexes prefer to be flat.
The M+ peak shows the mass of a single hydrogen atom added to the molecule.
A coordination number of 4 always means tetrahedral, because that gives the maximum bond-angle separation.
It can be either tetrahedral OR square planar — the shape depends on the metal and ligands (e.g. [Pt(NH3)4]2+ is square planar; [CuCl4]2- is tetrahedral).

mcqs.q: What are the units of Kc for a reaction?
options: A coordination number of 4 always means square planar because complexes prefer to be flat.
Kc always has units of mol dm^-3.
They depend on Δn (the difference between moles of gaseous/aqueous products and reactants) — Kc can be dimensionless or have units like mol dm^-3.
